'''2004 DPC Atlanta''' was a Star Wars CCG constructed tournament in Atlanta, Georgia (2004). It is known from the decklists below, recovered from DeckTech posts and Players Committee forms.

[[John Anderson]] posted the schedule of the DPC weekend at T and T Toys in Duluth, Georgia, on 20–22 February 2004. The Star Wars CCG events were a Saturday 21 February Early Bird tournament at 4 PM ($5, [[Classic]] format, four rounds; the winner received free entry to Sunday's event) and the Sunday 22 February Master Series event at 10 AM (sign-ups from 9 AM, decklists required, $20 entry, eight rounds and a cut to the top four, with 80% of entry fees going to prizes for the top four). The weekend also had Lord of the Rings, HeroClix, Ophidian 2350 and Magic events.<ref name="pcf-2224-39429">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=39429#39429 Georgia Tourneys], John Anderson (Shadow 29), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (12 January 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040318153120/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=40240%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Atlanta, Georgia (T and T Toys, 3750 Venture Drive NW, Duluth)<ref name="pcf-2224-39429" />
* '''Dates:''' 2004 (Master Series event scheduled for Sunday 22 February 2004)<ref name="pcf-2224-39429" />
